kit_name: Rear handbrake splitter/equalizer cable copy kit
target_market_or_shop: Montgomery Road auto-control-cable fabricator first; Bilal Ganj only for missing yoke/equalizer/clevis hardware by sample
sample_parts_checklist: Rear splitter/equalizer cable assembly; left rear wheel branch cable with sheath and backing-plate end; right rear wheel branch cable with sheath and backing-plate end; intermediate/front pull cable end or on-hand long cable for comparison; equalizer/yoke/splitter bar; clevises and threaded clevises; clevis pins; R-clips/split pins/safety clips; washers/spacers; adjuster nut/threaded rod/barrel adjuster; sheath stops/bracket stops/grooved ferrules; cable-end retainers; backing-plate lever clips; external return/assist springs; cable support clips/saddles; route photos with left/right labels
physical_samples_to_pack: Old rear handbrake splitter/equalizer cable assembly; both rear wheel branch ends; yoke/equalizer; clevises; pins; safety clips; adjuster; any return/assist springs; route photos
measurements_to_capture: Overall cable length; sheath length; exposed cable travel; bracket stop/groove positions; adjuster thread and travel; clevis/yoke widths; pin diameters; LH/RH branch lengths
fabrication_or_buy_instruction: Copy the old rear parking-brake splitter/equalizer assembly with new automotive cable, lined sheath where fitted, proper swaged ends, matching bracket stops, and original equalizer movement. Bench pull-test before accepting.
required_rating_or_material: Automotive parking-brake/control cable; corrosion-protected sheath; proper swaged/crimped cable ends; matching clevis/pin/clip hardware
reject_if: Generic straight cable only; bicycle/motorcycle cable; wire-rope clamps as permanent ends; welded/fixed equalizer; missing sheath stops; one wheel pulls before the other; no bench pull test

kit_name: Rear brake and handbrake spring copy kit
target_market_or_shop: Bilal Ganj brake hardware stalls; Montgomery Road brake parts shops; local spring maker only if automotive match is unavailable
sample_parts_checklist: Left and right upper shoe return springs; left and right lower shoe return springs; hold-down pins; hold-down cups/retainers; hold-down springs; adjuster/star-wheel springs; adjuster lever springs; parking-brake lever return/assist springs inside drum; external handbrake cable return/assist springs; shoe retaining clips/washers/E-clips; adjuster screw/star wheel and lever as geometry samples; parking-brake lever clip/hairpin; side labels and opened-drum photos; Centric hardware kit contents if on hand
physical_samples_to_pack: All old rear drum springs; hold-down pins/cups/springs; adjuster springs; parking-brake lever/cable return springs; side labels; Centric kit contents for comparison if on hand
measurements_to_capture: Free length; wire diameter; coil OD; hook orientation; installed side/location; spring count per side; hold-down pin length; cup diameter
fabrication_or_buy_instruction: Replace every rear drum and handbrake return/assist spring with new matching pieces. Use old parts only as patterns and compare any procured kit to the opened drum layout before installation.
required_rating_or_material: Automotive brake spring steel; correct tension and hook geometry; plated/corrosion-resistant finish preferred
reject_if: Hardware-store weak spring; wrong hook angle; too long/short; rubs drum/hub; incomplete side-to-side set; reused weak or rusty springs

target_market_or_shop: Montgomery Road brake hose crimp shop; Fine Auto/NDE/SNA brake hose lead as fallback; Bilal Ganj only for bracket/clip samples
sample_parts_checklist: Front left brake flex hose complete assembly; front right brake flex hose complete assembly; rear center frame-to-axle brake flex hose complete assembly; chassis-side hose fittings; axle/T-union side fittings; caliper/short-hard-line side fittings; banjo bolts and old copper washers if present as samples only; retaining U-clips; bracket tabs/grooves or bracket photos; rubber sleeves/grommets if fitted; nearby tee/union sample or photo; route photos at ride height; route photos at axle droop and steering lock
physical_samples_to_pack: Old front flex hoses if removed; old rear center frame-to-axle flex hose; retaining clips; bracket samples/photos; hose end fittings; route photos at ride height and droop/steering lock
measurements_to_capture: Free length; hose OD; end fitting type; thread/pitch; flare or banjo seat; bracket groove; clip style; chassis/axle/caliper side; droop and steering clearance
fabrication_or_buy_instruction: Create or buy complete crimped brake hydraulic hose assemblies only. Copy the old assemblies and end fittings exactly, then pressure/leak test after install.
required_rating_or_material: DOT/SAE J1401 or OEM-equivalent hydraulic brake hose assembly with crimped fittings
reject_if: Fuel hose; generic rubber hose; loose roll hose; industrial hydraulic hose without automotive brake rating; reused hose; unmatched end fittings; hose twists/stretches/rubs at droop or lock

target_market_or_shop: Land Cruiser parts counter; fuel-hose supplier; Bilal Ganj/Montgomery Road sample-match route
sample_parts_checklist: Main molded fuel filler hose; small filler-neck vent hose; metal filler neck/cap assembly as size sample only; tank filler neck/pipe or measured OD gauge; filler vent nipple/pipe sample; tank-to-chassis fuel feed hose sample; chassis-to-filter/lift-pump feed hose sample; fuel return hose sample; injector leak-off/overflow hose sample; tank breather/vent hose sample if separate; rubber grommets/pass-through sleeves on fuel lines if fitted; old clamps for size only; route photos and labels for each hose
physical_samples_to_pack: Old main fuel filler hose; metal filler neck and tank neck as size samples if possible; small vent hose; feed/return/leak-off hose samples; old clamps as size references only
measurements_to_capture: Main filler hose ID/free length/bend; filler neck OD; tank neck OD; vent nipple OD/ID; feed/return hose ID and length; clamp OD range; body/tank clearance
fabrication_or_buy_instruction: Copy/buy new fuel-rated rubber only. Reuse/restore metal filler neck/cap if sound. Main filler hose reference: 9/1972-12/1978 J40 FJ40/FJ45/BJ40 OEM 77217-60014 NBR; add fuel-rated vent/feed/return hoses and smooth-band clamps.
required_rating_or_material: Fuel-rated NBR or SAE J30 hose as appropriate; filler-neck hose for large fill hose; smooth-band/rolled-edge fuel clamps
reject_if: Coolant hose; vacuum hose; washer hose; used rubber; cracked NOS hose; sharp perforated clamps; generic small fuel line substituted for the large molded filler hose
